title: Pixel
description: 2D point coordinates (x, y) in pixel space.

x.description: Array of horizontal x-coordinates in pixels.

y.description: Array of vertical y-coordinates in pixels.

disjoint.description: Indicates whether all pixel coordinates are unique.

exhaustive.description: Indicates whether the pixel observations cover the coordinate range without missing observations.

min_x.description: Lower bound along x-axis in pixels.

max_x.description: Upper bound along x-axis in pixels.

min_y.description: Lower bound along y-axis in pixels.

max_y.description: Upper bound along y-axis in pixels.
